    code text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    name text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    description text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    is_active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT stocklocations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT "StockLocations_code_key" UNIQUE (code)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main"."StockMovements"
(
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    inventory_id bigint,
    product_id uuid NOT NULL,
    product_supplier_id uuid,
    movement_type text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    quantity integer NOT NULL,
    reference_type text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    reference_id uuid,
    notes text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_by bigint,
    CONSTRAINT stockmovements_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main"."SupplierBillItems"
(
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    supplier_bill_id uuid NOT NULL,
    purchase_order_item_id uuid NOT NULL,
    product_id uuid NOT NULL,
    quantity_billed integer NOT NULL,
    unit_price numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL,
    line_total numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp(0) without time zone,
    updated_at timestamp(0) without time zone,
    CONSTRAINT "SupplierBillItems_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main"."SupplierBills"
(
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    bill_number character varying(255) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    purchase_order_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status character varying(255) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    bill_date date NOT NULL,
    due_date date NOT NULL,
    total_amount numeric(15, 2) NOT NULL,
    notes text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    created_by bigint NOT NULL,
    approved_by bigint,
    paid_by bigint,
    paid_at timestamp(0) without time zone,
    created_at timestamp(0) without time zone,
    updated_at timestamp(0) without time zone,
    deleted_at timestamp(0) without time zone,
    voided_by character varying(36) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    voided_at timestamp(0) without time zone,
    CONSTRAINT "SupplierBills_pkey" PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT supplierbills_purchase_order_id_bill_number_unique UNIQUE (purchase_order_id, bill_number)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main"."Suppliers"
(
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    "CompanyName" text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    "CompanyContact" text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    "Email" character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    "ContactNumber" text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    "Viber" text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    supplier_code text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    address text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    payment_terms character varying(255) COLLATE pg_catalog."default" DEFAULT 'COD'::character varying,
    CONSTRAINT suppliers_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT "Suppliers_supplier_code_key" UNIQUE (supplier_code)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main"."Tax"
(
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    "Name" text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    "RatePercent" numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    CONSTRAINT tax_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT "Tax_Name_key" UNIQUE ("Name")
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main"."UnitOfMeasure"
(
    id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY ( INCREMENT 1 START 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 CACHE 1 ),
    name text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    abbreviation text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT unitofmeasure_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main"."UserCredentials"
(
    id bigint NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY ( INCREMENT 1 START 1 MINVALUE 1 MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807 CACHE 1 ),
    "employeeID" bigint,
    username character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    password_hash character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT usercredentials_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT "UserCredentials_employeeID_key" UNIQUE ("employeeID"),
    CONSTRAINT "UserCredentials_username_key" UNIQUE (username)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main"."UserEmployeeMap"
(
    user_id uuid NOT NULL,
    employee_id bigint NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    CONSTRAINT useremployeemap_pkey PRIMARY KEY (user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main"."VehicleModels"
(
    id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('"Main"."CarModels_id_seq"'::regclass),
    model character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    image_path text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    manufacturer_id bigint NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT vehiclemodels_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main"."VehicleVariants"
(
    id bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('"Main"."CarVariants_id_seq"'::regclass),
    car_model_id bigint NOT NULL,
    variant_name character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    engine_displacement text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    year character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    transmission_type character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    oil_capacity integer,
    service_class text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    drivetrain text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    fuel_type character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    body_type character varying(50) COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    CONSTRAINT vehiclevariants_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main"."Warranties"
(
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    "JOID" uuid NOT NULL,
    "VehicleID" character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    start_date date NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE,
    expiry date NOT NULL,
    status text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Active'::text,
    vehicle_id_new bigint,
    CONSTRAINT warranties_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main".cache
(
    key character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    value text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    expiration integer NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT cache_pkey PRIMARY KEY (key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main".cache_locks
(
    key character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    owner character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    expiration integer NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT cache_locks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main".failed_jobs
(
    id bigserial NOT NULL,
    uuid character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    connection text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    queue text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    payload text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    exception text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    failed_at timestamp without time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    CONSTRAINT failed_jobs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT failed_jobs_uuid_key UNIQUE (uuid)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main".job_batches
(
    id character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    name character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    total_jobs integer NOT NULL,
    pending_jobs integer NOT NULL,
    failed_jobs integer NOT NULL,
    failed_job_ids text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    options text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    cancelled_at integer,
    created_at integer NOT NULL,
    finished_at integer,
    CONSTRAINT job_batches_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main".jobs
(
    id bigserial NOT NULL,
    queue character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    payload text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    attempts smallint NOT NULL,
    reserved_at integer,
    available_at integer NOT NULL,
    created_at integer NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT jobs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main".migrations
(
    id serial NOT NULL,
    migration character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    batch integer NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT migrations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main".password_reset_tokens
(
    email character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    token character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp without time zone,
    CONSTRAINT password_reset_tokens_pkey PRIMARY KEY (email)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main".personal_access_tokens
(
    id bigserial NOT NULL,
    tokenable_type character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    tokenable_id bigint NOT NULL,
    name text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    token character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    abilities text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    last_used_at timestamp without time zone,
    expires_at timestamp without time zone,
    created_at timestamp without time zone,
    updated_at timestamp without time zone,
    CONSTRAINT personal_access_tokens_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT personal_access_tokens_token_key UNIQUE (token)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main".sessions
(
    id character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    user_id bigint,
    ip_address character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    user_agent text COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    payload text COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    last_activity integer NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT sessions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Main".users
(
    id bigserial NOT NULL,
    name character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    email character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    email_verified_at timestamp without time zone,
    password character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default" NOT NULL,
    remember_token character varying COLLATE pg_catalog."default",
    created_at timestamp without time zone,
    updated_at timestamp without time zone,
    CONSTRAINT users_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT users_email_key UNIQUE (email)
);
